final_message: The root cause was Clap’s mutual overrides: `--plain` discarded `--paging=never`, restoring automatic paging. I removed those overrides and explicitly preserve last-argument-wins paging behavior for `-pp`, so styling and paging remain independent. Added regression coverage without changing existing tests.
